classification.rationale: Podcast interview containing firsthand witness testimony of a 2012 UAP sighting at Langley AFB, claims of classified programs, and discussion of government whistleblower processes. Mixed content type due to witness narrative, media commentary, and historical references. Hynek scaffold inferred from described visual observation of a triangular craft with rapid acceleration. No classification markings detected. Public source but contains unverified extraordinary claims; proceed with caution for downstream analysis.

_raw_list: In summer 2012, at approximately 0130, Dylan Borland saw an approximately 100 ft equilateral triangle take off from near the NASA hangar at Langley Air Force Base.
The craft moved from about 100 ft off the ground to at least 30,000 ft in 2 to 3 seconds.
Borland was a former 1N1 geospatial intelligence specialist for the United States Air Force.
Someone who worked for the government heard him talking about the triangle and thought he was 'right into the program,' leading him to knowledge about a specific program.
The Intelligence Community Inspector General (ICIG) 'extremely hinted' that humans are not in charge.
Whistleblowers going to the ICIG are not allowed to be prosecuted for espionage if they disclose CIA or Department of Energy secrets.
A program name 'Rubik's Cube' was mentioned by an ODNI agent to Jeremy Corbell as a possible UFO reverse engineering program.
ODNI committed a felony against whistleblowers by disclosing whistleblower testimony to journalists.
Borland testified before Congress in September 2025.
Borland experienced reprisals and 'administrative terrorism' after his sighting and testimony.
He was subjected to a polygraph with flashing images and air horns, and had to count backwards from 100 by 7.
He has PTSD for a job the government claims he never did.
There are crafts not made by humanity that have been recovered.
The I-81 corridor between Norfolk/Langley AFB and Harrisburg, PA, has a history of UFO flaps.
The first CIA director, Roscoe Hillenkoetter, was on the board of directors for New Fork and was involved in UFO-related matters.
Majestic 12 may be tied to the National Security Council.
